summary: Iter-23: tested the new VIP 'Offer a pick-up instead' three-step flow end-to-end. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pickup_offer_flow.py 11/11 PASS: Step 1 POST /vip/schedule/bookings/{id}/pickup/offer requires inviter (403 for VIP), requires pending taxi (400 NO_TAXI_REQUEST), 400 PICKUP_PENDING on duplicate; happy path sets pickup.status='offered' and fires 'Pick-up offered' notification to VIP. Step 2 POST /pickup/address requires VIP (403), requires offer first (400 NO_PICKUP_OFFER), 400 ADDRESS_REQUIRED on blank; happy path persists address/city/postal/country/lat/lng/time/note, sets pickup.status='address_set', inviter notified; VIP can call again to edit. Step 3a POST /pickup/accept requires inviter (403), requires address_set (400 NO_PICKUP_ADDRESS); happy path sets pickup.status='accepted', taxi.status='replaced', booking confirmed. Step 3b POST /taxi/send while pickup offered/address_set correctly marks pickup.status='taxi_instead', taxi.status='sent', status='confirmed', charges coins. Playwright UI as admin on /vip-bookings → My Requests: card for a pending booking with taxi request shows vs-pickup-propose-{id} 'Offer a pick-up instead' (single click, no form); after click status flips to vs-pickup-status-{id} 'Pick-up offered — waiting for the VIP to add a location' and vs-taxi-send/decline are hidden. As VIP: Requests tab card shows 'Your inviter offers to pick you up' with vs-pickup-form-{id} containing AddressPicker (manual: Street/City/Postal/Country), vs-pickup-time-{id} and vs-pickup-note-{id}; after Send pick-up location, address + Edit pick-up location (vs-pickup-edit-{id}) appear. Back as admin: all three buttons appear — vs-pickup-accept-{id} 'Confirm pick-up location', vs-pickup-taxi-instead-{id} 'Send taxi instead 🪙 50', vs-pickup-cancel-date-{id} 'Cancel date'. Clicking Accept toasts 'Pick-up accepted — date confirmed', final status 'Pick-up agreed' with address + time + note; vs-pickup-directions-{id} Get-directions button is rendered. No console errors.
action_items: Legacy /app/backend/tests/test_pickup_arrived.py still targets the removed /pickup/propose and /pickup/decline endpoints — its propose/decline/accept tests will all fail on next regression run. Delete or port it to the new offer/address/accept endpoints (the new coverage already lives in test_pickup_offer_flow.py).
critical_code_review_comments: vs_pickup_address merges `req.model_dump(exclude={'time'})` into the existing pickup doc, which means every time the VIP edits the address, the Pydantic defaults (lat/lng/city/postal_code/country all `None`) overwrite values from a previous submit if the client sends only {address, time}. If the AddressPicker ever submits a sparse payload during editing, previously saved city/postal/lat/lng will be nulled. Consider `exclude_none=True` or merging only truthy fields.

vs_pickup_offer / vs_pickup_address / vs_pickup_accept do not touch the taxi coin side (no refund/charge) — correct, since nothing was spent — but there is no server-side guard against the VIP calling /pickup/address after the inviter already clicked /taxi/send (pickup.status becomes 'taxi_instead'). In that race the NO_PICKUP_OFFER check does fire (status != offered/address_set), so it is safe; worth a comment though.

pickup.time defaults to b['start'] if the HH:MM regex does not match — fine, but note that the frontend AddressForm initial state uses b.start (24h HH:MM) while the UI shows '08:00 PM', so Europeans entering '20:00' get persisted as 20:00 — consistent, good.

VipPickupBlock.jsx `canOffer` only shows the Offer button when (!pu || st === 'declined'); 'declined' is no longer produced by the new flow (replaced by 'taxi_instead'/'accepted'), so that branch is effectively dead code — safe to remove.
